# CANDIDATE: TRAIL_ACTIVATION_THRESHOLD_TIGHTEN_0.75ATR

**Filed:** 2026-07-22  
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)  
**Type:** exit_change  
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

Tightening the trail-stop activation threshold from 0.55 ATR to 0.75 ATR will reduce premature activation of the trailing stop on ELITE ribbon_ride entries, allowing the runner to capture more of the extended move on strong trend days. This should increase edge capture on J's winner days (where runners are valuable) while having minimal impact on loser days (where the trade is typically stopped early by the chart stop or premium stop).

## Mechanism

For entries classified as ELITE ribbon_ride (quality_tier == ELITE), the trail stop is currently armed when the price moves 0.55 ATR in favor of the trade. Change this activation threshold to 0.75 ATR. All other exit components remain unchanged: chart stop (primary invalidation), chandelier profit-lock (arms at +5%, trails 0.15), TP1 at +50% (sell 2/3), and time stop at 15:50 ET. The level-family harness will be used to run a Stage-1 backtest on recent SPY 0DTE data (e.g., last 3 months) to quantify changes in runner capture, win rate, and average winner size.

## OP-20 disclosures

1. **Account-size assumption:** Qty=28 requires $25K+ account; $1K paper account ≈14% of headline P&L (per OP-20 disclosure #1).
2. **Sample bias:** Stage-1 backtest will use recent SPY 0DTE data (approx 3 months) from the level-family harness; sample size ~60 trading days; selection method is recent window, risk of overfit to recent regime (e.g., low volatility) -- will need OOS validation.
3. **Out-of-sample:** NEEDS-OOS (walk-forward held-out window not yet performed).
4. **Real-fills:** NEEDS-REAL-FILLS (top 3 J days not yet validated with realistic OPRA slippage model).
5. **Failure modes:** Worst day: if the market gaps against the entry, the wider trail-stop activation may allow larger adverse excursion before stop triggers stop, increasing loss on loser days; max drawdown scenario: series of small adverse moves that never hit 0.75 ATR trail activation but accumulate via other stops; blow-up scenario: prolonged sideways market where trail never activates and positions bleed via time decay or small adverse moves.
6. **Concentration:** unknown -- requires Stage-1 backtest to compute top-5 days % of P&L.
